lines: A new face! Welcome! I'm Dottie, from the Maple Inn!
I'm the pie judge! I practised the eating part.
That wobble! My teacups fell right off the shelf!
Hear that hum? From the old oak, every night!
Isn't it a lovely morning? Even in the rain!
Mrs. Wren's clock only chimes on Tuesdays!
The gazebo's so pretty at night! Did you help?
